# LFA Capsule Fillers

> > LFA Capsule Fillers is a comprehensive supplier of capsule filling machines, empty capsules, excipients, and powder processing equipment for pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and food manufacturing.

LFA offers a complete range of manual, semi-automatic, and fully-automatic capsule filling solutions alongside complementary products like empty capsules, excipients, powder mixers, and polishing equipment. The company provides extensive customer support through installation, training, maintenance services, and educational resources via Solid Dose University.

## Key Topics

- Capsule Filling Machines
- FACF (Fully-Automatic Capsule Filler)
- SACF (Semi-Automatic Capsule Filler)
- ProCap (Manual Capsule Filler)
- Empty Capsules
- HPMC Capsules
- Gelatin Capsules
- Vegetable Capsules
- Excipients
- Powder Mixers
- Tapped Bulk Density Calculator
- Pharmaceutical Equipment
- Solid Dose Manufacturing
- Capsule Polishers
- Equipment Maintenance & Support

## Capsule Filling Machines

- [Capsule Filling Machines | Fully & Semi-Automatic Capsule Fillers](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/products/capsule-filling-machines): Main product catalog for automatic and semi-automatic capsule fillers including FACF and SACF series
- [Capsule Fillers | ProCap for Home & Laboratory | Filling Solution](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/products/manual-capsule-fillers): Manual capsule filler products including ProCap and PharmaCap for small-scale and laboratory applications
- [Which Capsule Filler Is Right For Me? | Machine Finder](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/right-capsule-filler-for-you): Interactive questionnaire tool to recommend suitable capsule fillers based on production needs

## Capsule Materials & Excipients

- [Empty Capsules | Vegetable & Gelatin | All Sizes In Stock](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/products/empty-capsules): Empty capsule product catalog with gelatin, HPMC, and pullulan options in all standard sizes
- [Excipients | Filling & Flowing Powders | LFA Capsule Fillers](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/products/excipients): Excipient products like Firmafill and Firmaoil for capsule formulation and powder flow enhancement

## Complementary Equipment

- [Powder Mixers | Industrial Powder Blenders | Food & Pharma](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/products/powder-mixers): Industrial powder mixer equipment for pharmaceutical and food applications
- [Capsule Polishers | Vacuum Units | LFA Capsule Fillers](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/products/capsule-polishers-vacuums): Capsule polishing and vacuum equipment including CP 7000 polisher for finishing operations
- [LFA Capsule Filling Machines Spare Parts | LFA Capsule Fillers](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/products/machine-spare-parts): Spare parts catalog for SACF and FACF capsule filling machines
- [Accessories - Products](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/products/accessories): Machine accessories including lubricants and greases for equipment maintenance

## Tools & Resources

- [Tools & Resources | Capsule Making Tools | LFA Capsule Fillers](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/tools-resources): Free tools including bulk density calculator and capsule size chart for formulation planning
- [Capsule Size Guide | Interactive Specification Chart](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/capsule-size-chart): Interactive capsule size specifications and capacity reference guide for all capsule types
- [Tapped Bulk Density Calculator | Work Out Powder Bulk Density](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/tapped-bulk-density-calculator): Bulk density calculation tool for powder formulation and testing
- [Solid Dose University](https://www.lfacapsulefillers.com/services/solid-dose-university): Educational platform for solid dose manufacturing and equipment training
